call_points.text: Targeting 1.2 million tonnes total steel volume in FY27 and 1.4 million tonnes in FY28.
Non-steel business revenue targeted at ₹750 Cr in FY27 (up 25%) and ₹925 Cr in FY28.
EBITDA margins targeted to expand to ~4% over the next two to three years.
Steel tubes and pipes volume guided to scale from 6.9 lakh tonnes in FY26 to 1 million tonnes in three years.
E-commerce revenue targeted at ₹35 Cr in FY27 and ₹50 Cr in FY28.
EBITDA margins stand at ~3% for steel segment and ~6.5% for non-steel segment.
Q4 results included ₹16 Cr of one-off costs covering demerger expenses, additional rent, and bad debt provisions.

operating_notes.text: Listed on stock exchanges on January 9, 2026 pursuant to the demerger scheme.
Total steel volume for FY26 stood at 10.2 lakh tonnes, up 32% from 7.7 lakh tonnes in FY25.
Company has 130 operational stores and fulfillment centers with a retail footprint of 5.4+ lakh sq.ft.
EBITDA margin for non-steel is around 6.5% and steel is around 3%.
Top 10-20 customers contribute around 1% of total top line.
Total bank loan facilities rated by CRISIL are ₹820 Cr, enhanced from ₹745 Cr, across cash credit and non-fund based/working capital limits at 12 banks.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,996.3 Cr, net profit ₹41.5 Cr.
Shankara Buildpro reported FY26 revenue of ₹6,826 Cr (up 30% YoY) and PAT of ₹128 Cr (up 64% YoY), driven by steel volumes reaching 10.2 lakh tonnes.
Shankara Buildpro Limited held its Q4 & FY26 earnings call on May 21, 2026, at 12:00 IST, with audio recording available at the company’s website.
Shankara Buildpro Limited corrected the Record Date for dividend from June 25, 2026 to June 24, 2026 due to a typographical error.
Shankara Buildpro held its Q4 & FY26 concall, guiding for 1.2 mn tonnes steel volume and ₹750 Cr non-steel revenue in FY27.

On 15 October 2026 CRISIL upgraded Shankara Buildpro's long-term rating to Crisil A/Stable from A-/Stable and short-term to Crisil A1 from A2+, with total rated bank facilities raised to ₹820 Cr from ₹745 Cr.
